templates.title: WebDAV
templates.name: webdav
templates.description: Web-based distributed authoring and versioning (WebDAV) is a set of extensions to the HTTP protocol that allows WebDAV clients (such as Microsoft Web Folders) to collaboratively edit and manage files on remote Web servers.
